# Best 18650 chargers

**Best overall: XTAR VC4SL, about $32.90**
- It has four independent bays, USB-C with QC3.0 input, and adjustable current from 0.25A to 3A. The LCD shows voltage, current, capacity and internal resistance per cell.
- It also has capacity-grading and storage modes, and fits protected 21700 cells.
- Best Batteries rates it 4.3/5, and VoltRated recommends it for 18650/21700 users.
- Caveats: it defaults to the highest charge current, so lower it for small cells. One reviewer saw it end NiMH charges early, and it doesn't list LiFePO4 support.
- Links: [price and review](https://us.best-batteries.com/reviews/xtar-vc4sl/), [1Lumen hands-on review](https://1lumen.com/battery-charger-review/xtar-vc4sl/)

**Best for speed and LiFePO4: Nitecore UMS4, about $38.95**
- It charges up to 3A in a single slot and 1A per slot with all four full, with independent slot control.
- It supports Li-ion, LiFePO4 and NiMH, and shows internal resistance. It has reverse-polarity and short-circuit protection, an overtime charging cutoff, and a fire-retardant housing.
- Links: [Nitecore spec page](https://www.nitecore.com/mobile-product/ums4), [price listing](https://us.best-batteries.com/reviews/xtar-vc4sl/)

**Best budget all-rounder: Keenstone 4-Bay Universal Charger**
- Smashing Robotics' Editor's Choice, with a 4.6-star average across 4,608 reviews.
- It has four independent bays, a selectable 500mA or 1000mA, and an LCD. It's listed as UL/CE/FCC certified and handles Li-ion, LiFePO4 and NiMH.
- Caveats: it's slower than the two above, and cells can lose some charge if left in after termination. That ranking comes from an affiliate site, and the search results gave no direct product link, so search the name on Amazon. Check the certification claims on the listing.
- Source: [Smashing Robotics roundup](https://www.smashingrobotics.com/best-18650-battery-chargers/)

**Best for travel: IMREN 2-Bay USB-C**
- Two bays at 1A each, with a 75mm slot that fits long protected cells. It's Li-ion only. Also covered in the [Smashing Robotics roundup](https://www.smashingrobotics.com/best-18650-battery-chargers/).

**My pick:** Get the XTAR VC4SL for most people, or the Nitecore UMS4 if you charge LiFePO4 or want the fastest single-cell charging. For either, use a QC-capable USB charger to get the faster speeds.

**Buying tips**
- Choose independent bays, not paired ones.
- Avoid no-name units that don't say how they decide a cell is full.
- Charging at lower current (0.5A) extends cell life when you're not in a hurry. ([VoltRated guide](https://voltrated.com/guides/best-chargers))

Prices are approximate and may vary by seller.
